crevasse_feature_definition.title: Crevasse Feature Definition
crevasse_feature_definition.$comment: Internal-only world generation feature added in preview 26.70.20; not available for creator content. Shape from the 26.70.20 changelog.

identifier.description: The identifier for this feature. The identifier must include a namespace and must match the filename.

max_length.description: Maximum end-to-end length in blocks, from 4 to 16; defaults to 16

max_width.description: Maximum cross-section width in blocks, from 2 to 8; defaults to 4

min_footprint.description: Minimum connected horizontal footprint required before carving, from 1 to 32 blocks; defaults to 10

twistiness.description: Amount of horizontal curvature, from 0.0 to 16.0; defaults to 4.0

carve_depth.description: Range used to select the carve depth below the origin terrain surface, from 4 to 32 blocks; defaults to [6, 10]

fill_depth.description: Range used to select the fill depth below the origin terrain surface, from 0 to 32 blocks; defaults to [4, 6]

surface_block.description: Optional block placed over the crevasse opening; omitted by default

fill_block.description: Optional block placed at or below the selected fill depth; omitted by default
